requirements.text: Customers can create orders by selecting products from the catalog.
requirements.source_sentence: Customers can create orders by selecting products from the catalog.

requirements.text: Each order must have a unique order ID generated automatically.
requirements.source_sentence: Each order must have a unique order ID generated automatically.

requirements.text: Orders with a total value over $500 require manager approval before processing.
requirements.source_sentence: Orders with a total value over $500 require manager approval before processing.

requirements.text: Premium customers receive free shipping on all orders regardless of order value.
requirements.source_sentence: Premium customers receive free shipping on all orders regardless of order value.

requirements.text: Standard customers pay a flat $9.99 shipping fee per order.
requirements.source_sentence: Standard customers pay a flat $9.99 shipping fee per order.

requirements.text: Orders can be in one of these states: pending, approved, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled.
requirements.source_sentence: Orders can be in one of these states: pending, approved, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled.

requirements.text: Customers can cancel an order only if it has not yet been shipped.
requirements.source_sentence: Customers can cancel an order only if it has not yet been shipped.

requirements.text: The system must send an email confirmation within 5 minutes of order placement.
requirements.source_sentence: The system must send an email confirmation within 5 minutes of order placement.

requirements.text: Payment processing must complete within 30 seconds or the order is marked as failed.
requirements.source_sentence: Payment processing must complete within 30 seconds or the order is marked as failed.

requirements.text: Each product in the catalog must have a name, description, price, and stock quantity.
requirements.source_sentence: Each product in the catalog must have a name, description, price, and stock quantity.

requirements.text: The system must prevent ordering products with zero stock quantity.
requirements.source_sentence: The system must prevent ordering products with zero stock quantity.

requirements.text: Order history must be retained for at least 7 years for compliance purposes.
requirements.source_sentence: Order history must be retained for at least 7 years for compliance purposes.

requirements.text: Managers receive a notification when an order requiring approval is placed.
requirements.source_sentence: Managers receive a notification when an order requiring approval is placed.

requirements.text: Premium customer status is granted when total lifetime spending exceeds $5,000.
requirements.source_sentence: Premium customer status is granted when total lifetime spending exceeds $5,000.

requirements.text: The system must generate a monthly sales report exportable as CSV or PDF.
requirements.source_sentence: The system must generate a monthly sales report exportable as CSV or PDF.
